The long top-left tail is drawn as a thin blue line running down to the bight at about (138,380). It reads as a stray stroke, not as a tail leaving the knot.

Labels collide: 'left edge of the knot body' overlaps 'upper-left overlapping loop', 'eye of the hitch' overlaps 'middle of the right-hand tail', and 'outer left edge of the bight' is struck through by the gold line. Several labels are unreadable.
The lower tail ends near (408,470) but the bight and lower tail join awkwardly at the junction around (284,358)-(293,413), so the tail does not clearly leave the bight.
